summary: JE Cleantech Holdings filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its Annual General Meeting held October 16, 2026 in Singapore. Shareholders re-elected five directors — Hong Bee Yin, Long Jia Kwang, Karmjit Singh, Tay Jingyan Gerald and Khoo Su Nee Joanne — and ratified WWC, P.C. as independent auditor for fiscal 2026. Record date was September 18, 2026 for Class A and Class B ordinary shares. No transaction, price, stake or advisor was disclosed. The filing is a routine meeting notice and outcome, offering no deal or risk-arb angle.
